what.text: Forced displacement from China includes refugees, asylum seekers, and internally displaced people.
In 2025, UNHCR recorded 153962 refugees and 99716 asylum seekers from China.
The sources don't say which specific countries host refugees or asylum seekers from China.

why.text: Conflict episodes recorded in the data include Government of China vs ETIM in 2008.
Conflict episodes also include Government of China vs Government of India in 2020.
The sources don't say why all individuals moved.

when.text: Disaster movements were reported at 18659649 in 2008 and 3501695 in 2025.
People displaced by disasters at the end of the year were recorded at 217356 in 2019, 157542 in 2020, 942638 in 2021, and 639183 in 2023.
Refugee numbers were recorded at 1200000 in 1964 and 153962 in 2025.

how.text: Disaster displacement counts movements forced by disaster events such as floods, storms, and earthquakes.
Asylum seekers are counted as people whose protection claims have not been decided at the end of the year.
The sources don't say how displaced people moved or where they live.
